name: Couch a laid thread
description: Lay a thread on the fabric and catch it with a finer thread so the thick thread stays on the surface.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Couch a laid thread.

levels.name: Lay the thread
levels.completion_criterion: Bring one or more strands to the surface and lay them together along a short line, without stitching that thread down through the cloth.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Catch a new hole
levels.completion_criterion: Bring a finer thread up on one side of the laid strands and take it down on the other side, in a new hole rather than the hole you just left.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Space the catches
levels.completion_criterion: Repeat those small catches at even gaps along the line, then take both threads to the back and fasten them.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.
